nouns.why_selected: All 11 non-function pages import Base.astro as the shared shell, the most inbound-edged file in the territory and the definitive layout spine.
The territory's sole stylesheet, imported by Base.astro and itself importing every font asset, making it the root of the visual tokens.
Imported once by Base.astro but rendered on every page through it, forming half of the site-wide chrome.
Imported once by Base.astro but rendered on every page through it, forming the other half of the site-wide chrome alongside Nav.
A 263-line component that contact.astro delegates the entire contact flow to, pairing with the contact serverless function.
The largest component in the territory at 552 lines, embedded on the homepage as the interactive pipeline demo.
Defines and types the writing, work, and people collections, all three of which are confirmed queried via getCollection across six page files.
Read by the Astro build toolchain by name under the toolchain-manifest contract; zero inbound edges but the whole build depends on it.
Declares the build scripts and Astro integrations the toolchain reads by name, live under the toolchain-manifest contract despite no inbound edges.
Invoked by Cloudflare Pages file-based function routing under the pages-functions contract, the backend counterpart to ContactForm.astro with no edge evidence of its own.

meanings: src/content.config.ts — the content-collection schema and loader definitions
src/content/work/ — the work content collection (case-study entries)
src/pages/work/ — the routed work section of the site
src/content/writing/ — the writing content collection (post entries)
src/pages/writing/ — the routed writing section of the site
